_comment_snowballs: Doubled (16→32) — the Preserve is meant to be humane; leave slack so weakening is a choice, not a grind (playtest 2026-08-06 N14).
_comment_exclusiveSpecies: Table species never spawn naturally anywhere — the Preserve is their only wild source; bait lures bypass the guard by construction (addFreshEntity never emits ENTITY_SPAWN).
_comment_stealth: Softened spook sensitivity (playtest 2026-08-06 N14 'should not spook as easy'): detectRange 10→7 (mons only alert when you're closer), alertChecks 3→5 (~2.5s of open line-of-sight before a bolt).
_comment_stagger: Push-your-luck: each snowball stagger multiplies catch rate by (1 + staggerCatchBonus × staggers), rolls an immediate bolt (staggerFleeChance × staggers), and thins the stealth alert threshold by one check per stagger (floor 1).
_comment_staggerFlee: Lowered 0.12→0.07: staggering (the un-humane path) spooks less, keeping the push-your-luck feel but softer (playtest 2026-08-06 N14).
_comment_trust: Trust meter (the HUMANE path). Offer the SAME bait that lured a mon (the treat) to raise trust +trustPerTreat; a mismatched bait still counts +1. At trustThreshold the lure is befriended: it never spooks, its window extends, its capture is easier (friendlyCatchBonus, applied in BOTH the real POKEMON_CATCH_RATE hook and the on-screen catch bar), and a befriended catch comes out at befriendedFriendship. Trust is PER-ROUND — it lives on the in-round lure and is gone at teardown, like every other safari state.
_comment_friendlyPoint: Raised 1→3: befriending is now the marquee humane payoff, so a befriended catch is worth a real contest premium.
